primitive.relation: two separate representations, each definitional: Hom U3 is_path is GTBase.walks_paths.seq_simple_walk s (uniq s && sorted (--) s, empty true); Cycle U6 is_path is Cycle.foundations.path_subgraphs.path_subgraph P (nonempty, connected, acyclic edge set of arc-end degree at most two)

sequence-empty-allowed.note: Hom U3 is_path: boolean uniq s && (if s is x :: p then path (--) x p else true), the body of seq_simple_walk s (MathComp sorted), convertible; the empty sequence is a simple walk, so it differs from family simple-path's seq_simple_path exactly on [::] (seq_simple_path_walk, seq_simple_walk_path).

multigraph-edge-set.note: Cycle U6 is_path: [/\ P != set0, subgraph_connected P, acyclic P & forall v, subdeg P v <= 2] on a multigraph edge set, the body of Cycle.foundations.path_subgraphs.path_subgraph P over acyclic_edge_set (U6's acyclic body), convertible; loops and parallel edges keep their behaviour and no looplessness or simplicity premise is added.

upstream_audit.note: Sequence class: U3's body is MathComp uniq && sorted (--), the whole-sequence form of coq-graph-theory's tail predicate upath (seq_simple_walk_upath on x :: q), with the empty sequence accepted; kept separate from the nonempty seq_simple_path of family simple-path. Multigraph class: coq-graph-theory's mgraph has edges, endpoints, incident and edges_at but no path-subgraph predicate; Cycle.foundations.connectivity owns subgraph_connected, is_circuit and arc-end subdeg, and Cycle.foundations.path_subgraphs adds acyclic_edge_set and path_subgraph over them without importing any conjecture. U6's own acyclic (also used by spanning_tree) is not a source of this family and is unchanged. U9 spath (no uniqueness) and XE2 xe2_path_in_graph (walk with repeats) stay separate. Legacy bodies and per-row certificates: meta/migration_reports/is_path.md.
